transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess... I just came in because nothing really feels like mine anymore. I used to get excited about things. Checking out murals, going for runs, basketball... even just making a good drink at work. But now... I just stand there. I don't really care about any of it.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like checking out murals, going for runs, playing basketball, or making a good drink at work?
Yeah... I mean, like I just said. That's exactly it. I just don't care about any of it anymore. I just... stand there.
Do you feel sad or down most of the time now?
I don't know. I haven't really... thought about it like that. I wouldn't say sad, exactly. Just... I don't know. I'm just here.
Have you noticed a decrease in pleasure or interest in most activities, even things you used to enjoy?

I... didn't you just ask me that? 

Yeah. Like I said... I just don't care about doing much of anything anymore.
Do you find yourself feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

I don't know. I mean... didn't we just cover this? 

I don't really know if I'd call it depressed. I'm just... I don't know. I'm just getting through the day.
Would you say you feel down or depressed most of the time, even if it's not all the time?
Look... I really don't have a different answer for you. I don't know how many ways you want me to say it. Like I just told you... I'm just here. I don't know what else to call it.
Would you say you feel down or depressed most days, even if it's not every single day?
...Are you even listening to me? I just told you. I don't have another answer for this. I don't know. Just... write down whatever you need to write down. I'm done trying to explain it.
Have you experienced a loss of pleasure or interest in activities you used to enjoy, beyond what you've already described?

Yeah... I guess. That's kind of why I came in. Just feels like... nothing is really mine anymore. I used to do things. Paint murals, go for runs, play basketball. Even at work, you know, I used to actually care about making a good drink. Now I just... I just stand there. I don't really care about any of it.
Have you noticed that you have less energy than before or feel fatigued most days, even when you’re not doing much?

Yeah... I suppose. It's just... heavy, I guess. Like at work, by the time I carry a couple cases of liquor from the back, or just... set up the well... my body feels like I've already worked a double. Even if I barely did anything that day. Just... tired.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or worthless lately, even about things you wouldn’t have thought much of before?

Yeah... I guess. I just... I keep thinking about the younger bartenders. And some of the artists I promised space to. I let them down. I pretty much wrecked their shot, so... whatever happens to me now, it feels like I deserve it. That's about it.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating more or less than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

I don't know... I guess I just don't eat much anymore. Most days I don't even think about it until my hands start shaking when I'm pouring drinks. Then maybe after closing I'll try to eat some cold leftovers in the back, but... just looking at it makes me feel sick. So, yeah. I guess I've lost weight.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep—like trouble falling asleep, waking up a lot during the night, or sleeping much more than usual?

I guess... it's not great. I'll lie down, and I'm tired, but... my head just keeps going over every mistake I made at work. It just won't shut off. And then... when I finally do get to sleep, I usually wake up around four or five. Can't get back down after that. So... yeah.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or that life isn't worth living anymore?
No... I don't think about doing anything like that. I mean, I know things are bad right now, but... I wouldn't actually hurt myself. So... no.
Have you noticed that it's harder to focus or think clearly lately, like following conversations or making decisions?

I guess so... yeah. It's... it's been harder. Inventory used to be automatic for me. Now I just... I stare at the bottles. I'll lose count two, three times. Or I'll just freeze up trying to figure out something stupid, like... like what garnishes to restock. I just can't seem to think straight.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in everything, including things that used to matter a lot to you, even beyond what you've already told me?

Yeah... I suppose so. That's kind of why I came in. It's just... nothing really feels like mine anymore. 

I used to care about things. Going for runs, watching basketball, checking out the murals around town... even just making a good drink for somebody at the bar. But lately... I don't know. I just stand there. I just don't care about any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way — like you don’t care about anything and everything feels heavy — has it been going on for more than two weeks?

Yeah... it's been longer than two weeks. Probably... about two months now. 

It started around the time the bar got bought out. Everything I'd been working toward just... got changed. So... yeah. Two months.
Have you noticed that your thoughts feel slowed down or that you're moving more slowly than usual?
I don't... I don't really think so. I haven't noticed moving any slower, anyway. I just... I just go to work and do what I have to do. I don't know.
Have you noticed that your thoughts feel slowed down, like it takes longer to process things, even when you're trying to focus?

I guess... maybe my thoughts, yeah. Like at work. 

Doing inventory used to just be automatic for me. But lately... I don't know, I'll just stare at the bottles. I end up losing count three times before I get it. Or I'll just... freeze up trying to decide something simple, like what garnish to restock. It just takes longer to figure it out now.
